meta.note: Refresh of the tokens in src/lib/constants.ts; values are the proposed v2, not what the app ships today. See "Current system" for v1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the cream every screen sits on. Also the ring that separates an avatar from the sheet it overlaps.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Sunken surfaces: segmented-control track, secondary buttons, reaction pills on cards, input fill on cards.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: feed cards, plan cards, list groups, sheets, the dock pill.

tokens.name: polaroid
tokens.usage: Photo paper: the polaroid frame, sticker die-cut edges, the date tile. Pure white in light; warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, paper-2, card and polaroid (14.9:1 on card light; 15.7:1 on paper dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, captions, quiet buttons. On paper, paper-2 and card in both themes (≥5.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: metadata, timestamps, inactive tab icons, placeholders. On paper, paper-2 and card (≥4.6:1 light, ≥5.4:1 dark). Replaces the old taupe #A0907E, which failed at 2.8:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers inside cards, chip outlines. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders at rest and the divider in a filter row.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The brand hue for marks, not text: the squiggle, sparkles on paper, illustration. Kept exactly from v1 (#C96442).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Action fill: primary buttons, the create button, the active tab, request banners. Text on it is on-clay (4.7:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: The "lip" under clay controls (a 3px hard shadow). Never a text color.

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Clay as text and icons: ghost buttons, links, tags. On paper, card, paper-2 and clay-wash (≥4.8:1 light, ≥6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: clay-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind clay-ink: your own reaction, the help tag, tonal buttons.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay fill. White in light; night ink in dark, where clay brightens.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Live presence only: the out-and-about pulse dot and presence rings. Never decoration.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Sticker fill: date stamps on photos and plans. Text on it is ink (9.7:1).

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Presence as text: "out & about", "at Cesar Chavez Park". On sun-wash and card (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: sun-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sun-ink: the presence chip.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Sage as a mark: dotted underlines in nudges, illustration. Not text.

tokens.name: sage-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for nudge actions ("snap one"). Text on it is on-sage (4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: The lip under sage-fill buttons.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: "Going" and "yes" as text; the nudge eyebrow. On card and sage-wash (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: sage-wash
tokens.usage: The nudge note ground; tonal "going" buttons.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sage-fill button.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors as text, always with an icon or the word. On card and paper (≥6.4:1).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text in inline errors.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted fill for the dock pill and controls over photos; pair with a 20px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Inner 1px highlight on glass surfaces.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: The translucent tape strip that pins a nudge note. Only on nudges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every surface (clay is ≥3:1 on paper, card and paper-2 in both themes).

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Laid over user photos in dark so bright photos don’t glare at night.

tokens.name: tone-peach
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is peach; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-peach-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-peach (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-golden
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is golden; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-golden-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-golden (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-sage
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is sage; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-sage-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-sage (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-mauve
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is mauve; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-mauve-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-mauve (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-slate
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is slate; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-slate-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-slate (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-rose
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is rose; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-rose-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-rose (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-butter
tokens.usage: Avatar fill for parents whose color is butter; also kid and venue placeholders. Same in both themes (it is the person’s color).

tokens.name: tone-butter-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on tone-butter (≥4.9:1).

groups.name: Voice
groups.note: Instrument Serif Italic, 21px and up: titles and the things parents say. Never for metadata.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The wordmark on sign-in. One per app.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Tab titles, lowercase, always over a squiggle.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Polaroid captions, questions, nudge prompts, section headers in lists.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque: everything a parent reads to get something done.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Names in rows and bylines; banner headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring water and a snack. We meet by the big oak.
styles.usage: Long text: plan descriptions, bios, comments.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: North Berkeley · parent to Sasha & Eli

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Buttons (M), chips, reaction counts, short labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text. The floor for anything a parent must read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tiny labels on photos and tab badges only.

groups.name: Stamp
groups.note: DM Mono, uppercase, tracked: dates, times and eyebrows. Reads like a date stamp on a snapshot.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Eyebrows above titles, date stickers, the date tile, counts like "2 PLANS".

spacing.note: 4px base. 20px is the screen gutter; 16px is inside cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight labels; avatar overlap is computed, not spaced.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between reaction pills; label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; dock pill to create button.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; list-row side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left and right of every tab).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between feed cards; between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a section title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: Soft and generous; every control is a capsule. Use continuous (squircle) corners on iOS: borderCurve: "continuous".

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The photo inside a polaroid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Stamps and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, emoji tiles, the date tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups (kept from v1).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and the profile sheet over its cover.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the dock, avatars.

shadow.note: Three soft elevations plus the lip: a hard 3px shadow under pressable clay and sage fills, the one tactile signature carried over from v1.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the polaroid.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The dock, sheets, anything that floats over scrolling content.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Stamps, emoji stickers, the date tile, emoji tiles.

tokens.name: lip-clay
tokens.usage: Under clay buttons (M, L), the create button and request banners. Pressed: 1px.

tokens.name: lip-clay-s
tokens.usage: Under small clay buttons and the active tab.

tokens.name: lip-sage
tokens.usage: Under sage-fill buttons.

size.note: Heights are fixed so rows line up.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-control-l
tokens.usage: Large buttons and inputs (sign-in, sheets).

tokens.name: size-control-m
tokens.usage: Default buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-s
tokens.usage: Small buttons and reaction pills inside cards (hit area padded to 44).

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the presence chip.

tokens.name: size-dock
tokens.usage: The dock pill and the create button.

tokens.name: size-avatar-s
tokens.usage: Avatar stacks.

tokens.name: size-avatar-m
tokens.usage: Bylines.

tokens.name: size-avatar-l
tokens.usage: List rows.

tokens.name: size-avatar-xl
tokens.usage: Profile header.
